Bill.BriefDescription: Limiting when the presence of a dog may affect the availability of homeowner's insurance.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to homeowner's insurance; and adding a new sectionto chapter 48.18 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 48.18 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: An insurer licensed to write liability insurance, such ashomeowner's insurance, in this state may not deny an application for ahomeowner's insurance policy, or cancel, refuse to renew, or modify anexisting homeowner's insurance policy, on the basis that the applicantor insured owns or harbors a specific breed of dog on the realproperty, unless the dog is a dangerous dog as defined in RCW16.08.070.
